name: Dev Tools
author: IrishBruse
description: Dev companion: watch local mods, DevTools, auto-load save, disable autosave, F3 overlay. Debug builds install it; release stages build/dev-tools/.

enabled.descriptionKey: Disable helpers without removing the mod.

autoLoad.descriptionKey: Skip splash and main menu. Loads the save below.

startSave.descriptionKey: Last played, or mod storage (set with api.storage from another mod). Empty storage uses last played.

disableAutosave.descriptionKey: Stop session autosave. Manual saves still work.

watchLocalMods.descriptionKey: Re-eval other mods' main.js when the file changes. Not workers or patches.

fastBoot.descriptionKey: Skip foliage generate on boot (dev). Raster and shaders stay vanilla. Restart once after you turn it on.

openDevTools.descriptionKey: Open DevTools when the mod loads.

crispCanvas.descriptionKey: Use nearest-neighbour scaling on the world canvas so zoom stays sharp instead of blurry.
